title: Notification Start Date and Due Date
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
The maximum agreed offset and maximum notification offset are specified by way of the Customizing activity
Define Processing Variants for Disconnection Documents. You access this activity by way of the following path:
SAPUtilities + CustomerService » Process Execution } Disconnection/Reconnection

Notification Start Date and Due Date

If notification is required, the CRM agent must contact the customer within a specified time period:

e The earliest date and time that the agent can contact the customer are defined as the notification start date and time.

e The notification due date and time that appears on an agent's work list is defined as the notification due date and time —
note however that it is still possible to contact the customer after this date, if required.

These dates and times are calculated using the planned disconnection date and time — more specifically, the system subtracts the
start date offset and due date offset from this date to determine the notification start and end dates.

The start date offset and due date offset are specified by way of the Customizing activity Define Processing Variants for
Disconnection Documents. You access this activity by way of the following path: |»SAPUtilities s CustomerService Process
Execution  Disconnection/Reconnection

An Agreed Date is Always Set in the Backend

When notification is not required, an agreed date is not set from the standpoint of the user — however in the backend, the system
automatically sets the agreed date to equal the planned disconnection date.

Therefore an agreed date is always set in the backend, whether or not customer notification is required.

The Agreed Date is the Actual Date That a Technician or the System Disconnects a Device

Devices selected in the disconnection order are always disconnected on the agreed date , since it is set, either by customer
notification or by automatic mapping to the planned disconnection date.

Processing Disconnection Orders

Once an agreed date has been set, you can complete the disconnection order. Choose the Save button to save the order. If an
order code and PM plant order number are provided, the system generates a service order, which can be processed by a service

technician.

Generating Disconnection Orders Without a Dialog

Disconnection orders can also be generated without a dialog. However, you do not have any control over the number of objects to
be disconnected or over the other parameters in this case.

Monitoring Disconnection Activities

You can monitor the status of disconnection orders and access all corresponding screens related to these orders (for example,
object information screen, work order information screen) . For more information, see Monitoring Disconnection and Reconnection
Activities .

Changing Disconnection Dates

e Customer requests — changing the agreed date
